narrative: On the part. A cue-roll on the desk, morning light, one greeting struck through. The margin is clear of any letter K. On the part. Further down the roll, the last speeches are out of the frame. Nothing is marked in the margin there. The pen is not on that part of the leaf. On the part. The head of the king's part, untouched, the same opening as the week has already left it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Struck the greeting, spared the ending, and left the opening line.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on part in One greeting
